    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BeginRepair" name="Begin repair"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckAvailableItems" name="Check which materials and tools are already available"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends about borrowing or buying items cheaply"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BuyRemainingItems" name="Buy the remaining items"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GetInstructions" name="Receive repair instructions from the tool"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_RepairPhone" name="Repair the phone"/>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SubmissionJoin" name="Join review and video paths"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendToExpert" name="Send the phone to an expert"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReviewSent" name="Review and/or video sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SentToExpert" name="Phone sent to an expert"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_BeginRepair" targetRef="Task_EnterPhoneDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_EnterPhoneDetails" targetRef="Task_GetListsAndOptions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_GetListsAndOptions" targetRef="Task_CheckAvailableItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CheckAvailableItems" targetRef="Task_ContactFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems" targetRef="Task_GetInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_GetInstructions" targetRef="Task_RepairPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_RepairPhone" targetRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairSucceeded" name="Worked" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome" targetRef="Gateway_SubmissionSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The repair worked</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairFailed" name="Did not work" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome" targetRef="Task_SendToExpert">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmissionToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_SubmissionJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_ReviewSent"/>

rules.instruction: When the description states that software automatically produces or presents information for a person: Model the software’s provision of that information as a service task, rather than modeling the person’s receipt of it as a user task.
rules.situation: the description states that software automatically produces or presents information for a person

rules.instruction: When the description states the action, purpose, recipient, scope, or outcome of a process element: Label the corresponding BPMN element with a concise phrase that preserves those stated semantics; do not substitute a related but different meaning, omit distinguishing details, or add unsupported details.
rules.situation: the description specifies the action, purpose, recipient, information, or outcome of an activity, decision, or other process element

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly states that an activity follows the process start or another activity: connect the corresponding BPMN elements with sequence flows in the stated order, preserving any intervening gateways and branches
rules.situation: the description explicitly states that one activity occurs after the process start or another activity

rules.instruction: When the description names an activity or milestone for which a BPMN task is being labeled: Label the task to preserve the action and purpose stated in the description; do not substitute a related but different action or milestone.
rules.situation: the description states an activity’s action, object, purpose, recipient, or outcome

rules.instruction: When the description provides directions for a person to perform physical work themselves: model the person's execution as a manual task in sequence after the directions are provided
rules.situation: the description provides directions for a person to perform physical work themselves
